title: Decision tree finite representation
statement: For each $n$, the decision-tree hypotheses on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube have a finite representation consisting of a code type, a binary-string encoder and decoder with decoding after encoding recovering every code, an evaluator returning a Boolean function, and an evaluation-work count depending only on the code.
